selected.rationale: 100% loss on compose-post->unique-id removes the ID-generation prerequisite; with no timeout/retry the synchronous compose-post call hangs until the client deadline, confirming missing timeout/retry on a critical first-step dependency.

Loss on compose-post->post-storage prevents the post from being persisted; lacking retry/fallback on this core write makes the entire compose operation fail or hang, exposing availability/persistence weakness.
Loss on home-timeline->social-graph breaks the read-path prerequisite for fetching the follow graph; without a timeout the home-timeline request can hang, exposing missing read-side timeout/fallback.
Loss on home-timeline->post-storage cuts off post content retrieval, so timeline rendering fails or hangs; no retry/fallback on this core read edge is a confirmed weakness.

Delay injected on compose-post->unique-id propagates 1:1 through the synchronous write chain and, without a timeout, turns into unbounded latency at the entry point; confirms no defensive timeout on a critical dependency.

Delay on compose-post->post-storage stalls the core persistence step; because the caller waits without a timeout, the entire compose operation can hang to the client deadline, exposing latency propagation.

Loss on compose-post->home-timeline loses the fan-out update for follower feeds; the synchronous no-timeout call can hang composition or silently miss timeline updates, revealing write-path coupling and missing retry.
Loss on compose-post->user-timeline breaks the user's own feed update; with no retry/timeout this write-path edge either hangs the compose request or creates data inconsistency.
Loss on compose-post->user removes the user validation/detail lookup needed to build the post; a missing timeout/retry makes this synchronous core call hang or fail the whole compose request.
Loss on compose-post->text prevents text processing in the write path; the synchronous dependency without timeout/fallback can hang post creation, confirming fragile coupling in the compose fan-out.
